title: Anyone ever had this dream of a long dark hallway with red carpet?
content: Warning don't read this before bed.⚠️ I first had this dream when I was 4. The dream starts with me in a very alive casino. You can hear old slot machine sounds as well as crowds cheering. Looks like 70s 80s or 90s decor style. The dream then proceeds with me in a long dark hallway with red persian carpet. I'm pretty sure this is a casino hotel in vegas. There are many doors. When I was 4 I remember I entered one of these rooms in the hallway and it was nearly pitch black with the certain opened from the wind coming in. All I can see is this horrendous black venom looking shadow standing by the bed. I eventually get trapped into the bed unable to move and the figure stands over me and electrocutes me until I wake up. I only had this dream once. I wonder if this is related to mallworld. Have any one you had any similar dream?.
